representative_place: Gröba – church and historic port area
facts: Gröba is the oldest district of Riesa: it is first documented in 1064 and was incorporated into Riesa in 1923. Before industrial development, it was an independent village with an important manor.

Gröba lies where the Döllnitz meets the Elbe, and this location enabled the creation of a large port. Between 1886 and 1888, a railway, transport and winter harbour was built here, also intended for dozens of cargo vessels to spend the winter.

The rapid development of transport turned Gröba into an industrial area. The railway, port and associated industrial businesses made Riesa one of the important transport and production hubs on the Saxon Elbe.

Gröba liegt an der Mündung der Döllnitz in die Elbe, und diese Lage ermöglichte die Entstehung eines großen Hafens. Zwischen 1886 und 1888 entstand hier ein Eisenbahn-, Verkehrs- und Winterhafen, der auch zum Überwintern von Dutzenden Frachtschiffen diente.

Die rasche Entwicklung des Verkehrs machte Gröba zu einem Industriegebiet. Eisenbahn, Hafen und die angeschlossenen Industriebetriebe machten Riesa zu einem wichtigen Verkehrs- und Produktionsknoten an der sächsischen Elbe.

facts: Gröba è il quartiere più antico di Riesa: è documentato per la prima volta nel 1064 e fu incorporato a Riesa nel 1923. Prima dello sviluppo industriale era un villaggio indipendente con un'importante tenuta signorile.
